title: AI Stock Analysis Bot
desc: An intelligent stock analysis bot built with Python, OpenAI, and GitHub Actions that automatically generates daily email reports with top 5 stock performers, historical charts, and AI-driven investment recommendations.
shortDesc: AI-powered stock analysis with automated email reports and investment insights
desc1: Developed a sophisticated stock analysis system using Python for data processing, OpenAI GPT for market analysis, and GitHub Actions for automated daily execution. The bot scrapes real-time market data, identifies top performers, generates performance charts, and provides AI-driven investment recommendations.
desc2: The system features automated email delivery with detailed market analysis, historical performance visualization, and predictive insights for next-day trading decisions. Integrated with multiple financial APIs and leverages machine learning for pattern recognition and trend analysis.
featuredDesc: An innovative AI-driven financial tool that combines market data analysis with artificial intelligence to provide actionable investment insights through automated daily reports.

statusItem.title: Features
statusItem.desc: Daily Reports, Chart Generation, AI Analysis

descItems.title: Technical Innovation
descItems.desc: Built an end-to-end automated system that combines financial data scraping, AI-powered analysis, and automated reporting. The bot runs daily via GitHub Actions, processes market data using Python libraries, generates visual charts, and uses OpenAI to provide human-readable investment insights.

descItems.title: AI Integration & Impact
descItems.desc: Leveraged OpenAI's GPT models to analyze market trends, company fundamentals, and technical indicators to generate actionable investment recommendations. The system processes complex financial data and translates it into clear, actionable insights for informed investment decisions.

title: Portfolio Backend API
desc: A comprehensive backend service for personal portfolio management with JWT authentication, daily blog management, and complete CRUD operations built with Node.js, Express, and modern backend technologies.
shortDesc: Full-featured backend API with authentication and blog management
desc1: Developed a robust backend API using Node.js and Express.js with comprehensive authentication system, blog management capabilities, and portfolio content administration. Features JWT-based security, database integration, and RESTful API design.
desc2: The backend includes user authentication, protected routes, daily blog posting system, image uploads, content management, and database operations. Built with scalability and security in mind, featuring middleware for authentication, validation, and error handling.
featuredDesc: A professional-grade backend service that powers portfolio websites with secure authentication, content management, and comprehensive API endpoints for seamless frontend integration.

descItems.title: Architecture & Security
descItems.desc: Built a scalable backend architecture with JWT-based authentication, secure password hashing, protected routes, and comprehensive input validation. Implemented middleware for authentication, logging, and error handling to ensure robust and secure API operations.

descItems.title: Content Management Features
descItems.desc: Developed a complete blog management system with CRUD operations, image upload handling, content scheduling, and portfolio data management. The API supports daily blog posting, content categorization, and seamless integration with frontend applications.

title: Daily Dev Digest
desc: An intelligent web scraping system that aggregates top technology blog posts, rewrites them in a personalized tone using OpenAI, and delivers curated daily tech digest via automated GitHub Actions workflow.
shortDesc: Automated tech news curation with AI rewriting and personalized delivery
desc1: Built a comprehensive content aggregation system using Python for web scraping, OpenAI for content rewriting, and GitHub Actions for automation. The system crawls multiple tech blogs, identifies trending posts, and rewrites them in a consistent personal tone.
desc2: Features intelligent content filtering, duplicate detection, sentiment analysis, and automated publishing workflow. The AI rewriting ensures consistent voice and style while maintaining technical accuracy and readability across all curated content.
featuredDesc: A sophisticated content curation platform that combines web scraping, AI content processing, and automation to deliver personalized daily technology insights.

descItems.title: Intelligent Content Processing
descItems.desc: Developed a sophisticated web scraping system that monitors multiple technology blogs, identifies trending content using engagement metrics, and filters posts based on relevance and quality. The system handles dynamic content, respects robots.txt, and implements intelligent rate limiting.

descItems.title: AI-Powered Content Transformation
descItems.desc: Integrated OpenAI's language models to rewrite technical content while maintaining accuracy and adding personal perspective. The AI system preserves technical details, improves readability, and ensures consistent tone across all curated articles, creating a unique voice for the daily digest.

title: Modern Portfolio Website
desc: A sophisticated portfolio website built with Next.js 15, featuring advanced UI/UX elements including custom color palettes, seamless light/dark theme switching, and modern interactive components.
shortDesc: Next.js portfolio with advanced theming and interactive features
desc1: Created a cutting-edge portfolio website using Next.js 15 with React 19, featuring 10 unique homepage layouts, dynamic theming system, and comprehensive design components. Implemented advanced animations, responsive design, and optimal performance optimization.
desc2: The website showcases modern frontend development techniques with custom color palette system, smooth theme transitions, GSAP animations, and interactive elements. Features include blog system, portfolio galleries, and seamless user experience across all devices.
featuredDesc: A showcase of modern frontend development skills with advanced theming, animations, and responsive design principles implemented in a professional portfolio website.

descItems.title: Advanced Frontend Architecture
descItems.desc: Implemented a sophisticated frontend architecture using Next.js 15's app router with React 19. Created a flexible theming system with custom color palettes, built reusable component library, and optimized performance with code splitting and lazy loading.

descItems.title: User Experience Innovation
descItems.desc: Developed an intuitive theme switching system, smooth animations with GSAP, and responsive design that works seamlessly across all devices. The website features multiple layout variants, interactive elements, and optimized loading performance for excellent user experience.

title: Smart Expense Tracker
desc: An intelligent Android mobile application that syncs with inbox messages every minute to automatically track expenses and provides AI-powered financial insights using Android Studio, Python backend, and OpenAI integration.
shortDesc: AI-powered mobile expense tracker with inbox message analysis
desc1: Developed a comprehensive mobile expense tracking application using Android Studio with Python backend integration. The app automatically reads inbox messages, extracts transaction data, categorizes expenses, and provides AI-driven financial analysis and spending recommendations.
desc2: Features real-time inbox synchronization, intelligent expense categorization, spending pattern analysis, and personalized financial insights. The AI system learns from spending habits and provides actionable recommendations for better financial management and budgeting.
featuredDesc: An innovative mobile application that combines automated expense tracking with artificial intelligence to provide comprehensive financial insights and spending optimization recommendations.

descItems.title: Automated Data Processing
descItems.desc: Built an intelligent system that monitors inbox messages every minute, extracts transaction information using natural language processing, and automatically categorizes expenses. The system handles various message formats from banks, payment apps, and service providers with high accuracy.

descItems.title: AI-Driven Financial Insights
descItems.desc: Integrated OpenAI to analyze spending patterns, identify trends, and provide personalized financial recommendations. The AI system generates detailed expense reports, suggests budget optimizations, and alerts users about unusual spending patterns or potential savings opportunities.

title: React Mini-Games Collection
desc: A collection of engaging mini-games built with React for leisure and fun activities, featuring interactive gameplay, responsive design, and smooth animations for an entertaining user experience.
shortDesc: Interactive React-based mini-games for entertainment and leisure
desc1: Created a diverse collection of mini-games using React with modern hooks, state management, and interactive animations. Games feature responsive design, engaging gameplay mechanics, and smooth user interactions for enjoyable leisure activities.
desc2: The collection includes various game types with different difficulty levels, score tracking, and responsive controls. Each game is optimized for both desktop and mobile devices, featuring intuitive interfaces and entertaining gameplay mechanics.
featuredDesc: A fun collection of interactive mini-games showcasing React development skills, state management, and creative user interface design for entertainment purposes.

descItems.title: Interactive Game Mechanics
descItems.desc: Developed various mini-games with different gameplay mechanics including puzzle solving, reaction-based challenges, and strategy games. Each game features intuitive controls, progressive difficulty levels, and engaging visual feedback to keep players entertained.

descItems.title: Technical Implementation
descItems.desc: Utilized React hooks for state management, implemented smooth animations with CSS transitions, and created responsive layouts that work across different screen sizes. The games feature score persistence, performance optimization, and clean, maintainable code structure.
